$schema_note: Checked-in allowlist for the TEST-ONLY Family-1 underscore-named remainder of the import-hygiene CI gate (dev/quality/import_hygiene_scan.py). Read by dev/tests/test_import_hygiene_gate.py. Every entry here is a NAMED, REASONED test-only white-box reach into a private implementation symbol (a private repository-factory function, a private evaluator, a private module-level cache, a private constant that intentionally has no public promotion candidate) that was deliberately NOT promoted to a public facade (an underscore-named candidate gets an individual per-symbol disposition, not mechanical promotion; promoting an internals-only helper, a private cache, or a private constant onto a public facade would pollute the facade with implementation detail no other consumer needs). The gate FAILS if a NEW, undocumented test-only underscore-named private import appears that is not in this list; it does not fail if the count is lower. A production (non-test) violation is NEVER tolerated here -- this file governs test-only debt exclusively; see dev/quality/import_hygiene_baseline.json for the production Family-1 cycle-break baseline.

test_only_family1_underscore_reaches._note: Each site is a test file reaching a foreign package's private submodule to exercise an internal helper, evaluator, repository factory, or module-private constant/cache by name. Grouped by owning package below for readability; the gate reads the flat 'sites' list. Each site records an 'occurrence' ordinal -- 1-based among the entries sharing its (importer_path, target_mod, imported_names) triple, in the order the reaches appear in the importing file -- because one reach can occur several times in a file, each reasoned separately, and something has to say which reason belongs to which site. It replaces a stored line number, which was a cache of a scan with nothing to invalidate it and had drifted on roughly half the entries; the live line is recoverable from dev/quality/import_hygiene_scan.py at any time, whereas the ordinal only moves when the number of occurrences moves, which the gate checks.

White-box identity gate, and the reach is the assertion. This module proves that the Modelo 303 regimen-simplificado scope has NO caller-authored override boundary: scope derives from the secured taxpayer profile alone, never from an export-side input. `test_canonical_profile_scope_mapper_is_required_by_calculation_and_export` asserts that the mapper bound inside `application.modelo._m303_filing_evidence` and the one bound inside `application.modelo._export` are the SAME object as the canonical definition -- an `is` comparison that must name the defining private module to have anything to compare against. Deliberately NOT promoted: the symbol has zero cross-package production consumers (its only callers are `_export`, `_m303_filing_evidence`, and its own module's `resolve_m303_regimen_simplificado_scope`), and minting it onto `application.modelo`'s public facade would create precisely the caller-reachable scope-override door this module exists to prove does not exist. Promotion here would make the gate assert the absence of a surface the promotion itself had just added.

White-box test of the wizard widgets' private validation-context redaction helper. Internal privacy-redaction helper with no consumer outside the wizard package; promoting it would expose an internal implementation detail as public API. This reach is STILL LIVE and unchanged in the source. It stopped being reported because its target module was promoted from a private to a public name, and the scanner decides what is private from the module path alone without ever inspecting the imported names, so a private symbol reached through a public module is invisible to it. The entry is retained deliberately: deleting it would record a resolution that did not happen, and it will answer a live occurrence again once the scanner judges imported names too.

White-box test of the private CLI notice builder that warns an attachment landing after a revision was verified will never reach the frozen evidence bundle. Notices are the CLI's own diagnostic channel, so the builder belongs to the CLI layer and has no application-layer promotion candidate; the test asserts the advisory's structured suggestion rather than localized prose, which requires the builder itself. Observation for a future pass: an application-layer test reaching into entrypoints is a layering smell worth revisiting when the ledger-lifecycle advisory surface is next touched, but relocating the builder out of the CLI would contradict the notices-are-the-CLI-channel contract.

White-box projection-parity gate: it asserts every InvoiceDraft field survives onto the operator-facing confirm payload, in both directions, so it must hold the CLI's own payload models alongside the application-layer models they project from. The set widened from the top-level EvidenceExtractResult to the five nested pairs beneath it, because the nested models are hand-mirrored and every payload model forbids extras, so a draft sub-model gaining a field its payload lacks makes a CORRECT operator confirm command return a refusal. These are the CLI's rendering-layer shapes for one verb family, not a cross-package production API, and have no promotion candidate on the entrypoints.cli facade. The gate exists precisely because the two ends can silently diverge, so it must see both ends directly rather than through a double.
